examples.label: Notification preferences in account settings
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-group-checkbox" site="Global" id="account-notifications" name="notifications[]" space="small">
Send me an email when
<:checkbox value="comment" checked={true}>Someone comments on a page I wrote <:checkbox value="publish">A page I edited goes live <:checkbox value="invite">I am invited to another site <:checkbox value="digest">The weekly activity digest is ready

examples.label: Availability filter in a shop sidebar
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-group-checkbox" site="Global" id="shop-filter-availability" name="availability[]" space="extra_small" size="small" label_class="block text-sm">
Availability
<:checkbox value="in_stock" checked={true}>In stock now (128) <:checkbox value="made_to_order">Made to order (34) <:checkbox value="preorder">Pre-order (9) <:checkbox value="clearance">Clearance (17)

examples.label: Column picker laid out in a row above a report
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-group-checkbox" site="Global" id="report-columns" name="columns[]" variation="horizontal" space="large" size="small" label_class="block text-sm">
  <:checkbox value="title" checked={true}>Title</:checkbox>
  <:checkbox value="author" checked={true}>Author</:checkbox>
  <:checkbox value="published_at">Published</:checkbox>
  <:checkbox value="views">Views</:checkbox>
  <:checkbox value="comments">Comments</:checkbox>
</.component>
